Test Case Description: Verify login with valid username and password
Precondition: User is on the SauceDemo login page
Test Steps: 1. Enter valid username 2. Enter valid password 3. Click Login
Expected Result: User should successfully log in and Products page should be displayed.

Precondition: User is on the SauceDemo login page
Test Steps: 1. Enter invalid username 2. Enter valid password 3. Click Login
Expected Result: Appropriate error message should be displayed and login should fail.

Precondition: User is on the SauceDemo login page
Test Steps: 1. Enter valid username 2. Enter invalid password 3. Click Login
Expected Result: Appropriate error message should be displayed and login should fail.

Test Case Description: Verify validation when username is blank
Precondition: User is on the SauceDemo login page
Test Steps: 1. Leave username blank 2. Enter password 3. Click Login
Expected Result: Username validation message should be displayed.

Test Case Description: Verify validation when password is blank
Precondition: User is on the SauceDemo login page
Test Steps: 1. Enter valid username 2. Leave password blank 3. Click Login
Expected Result: Password validation message should be displayed.

Test Case Description: Verify validation when both fields are blank
Precondition: User is on the SauceDemo login page
Test Steps: 1. Leave username blank 2. Leave password blank 3. Click Login
Expected Result: Validation message should be displayed and login should not proceed.

Precondition: User is on the SauceDemo login page

Test Case Description: Verify locked user cannot log in
Precondition: User is on the SauceDemo login page
Test Steps: 1. Enter locked user credentials 2. Click Login
Expected Result: User should not be allowed to log in and an appropriate error should be displayed.

Test Case Description: Verify error message for invalid login
Precondition: User is on the SauceDemo login page
Expected Result: A clear login error message should be displayed.

Test Case Description: Verify user can log out successfully
Expected Result: User should be logged out and returned to the login page.

Test Case Description: Verify products are displayed after successful login
Expected Result: Products should be displayed after successful login.

Test Case Description: Verify product name is displayed correctly
Expected Result: Product name should be visible and readable.

Test Case Description: Verify product description is displayed correctly
Expected Result: Product description should be displayed correctly.

Test Case Description: Verify product price is displayed correctly
Expected Result: Product price should be displayed correctly.

Test Case Description: Verify product image is displayed correctly
Expected Result: Product image should be displayed correctly.

Test Case Description: Verify user can open product details
Verify user can add a product to cart
Test Steps: 1. Select a product 2. Click Add to Cart
Expected Result: Selected product should be added to the shopping cart.

Test Case Description: Verify multiple products can be added to cart
Test Steps: 1. Select product 1 2. Select product 2 3. Add both to cart
Expected Result: Both selected products should appear in the cart.
